name: KorNAT
description: KorNAT is the first benchmark measuring national alignment of large language models with South Korea, focusing on social value alignment and common knowledge alignment. It contains 4,000 multiple-choice questions on social values derived from a large-scale survey and 6,000 questions on common knowledge based on textbooks and GED materials. The benchmark is government-approved and aims to evaluate LLMs' cultural and knowledge alignment with Korean society.
reputation: A new benchmark with emerging interest for measuring Korean cultural and knowledge alignment in LLMs, especially in the context of national alignment evaluation.
notes: Includes government-approved dataset with rigorous sampling and human review; focuses on Korean social values and knowledge.
